name: Crisp Formal
description: Hairline borders, near-flat surfaces, unhurried spacing. Reads as deliberate and unshowy rather than severe.
harvestedFrom: uupm styles.csv row 1, Minimalism & Swiss Style (--border-radius: 0px, --shadow: none) — tuned up from 0px to 2px; 0px read too severe on a still-human-facing law firm when checked against a real render (see this task's log entry)
uupm styles.csv row 51, Swiss Modernism 2.0 (--base-unit: 8px, Best For explicitly names 'professional services')

name: Warm Approachable
description: Soft corners, gentle card lift, cozier section spacing. Reads as inviting without tipping into playful.
harvestedFrom: uupm styles.csv row 19, Soft UI Evolution (--border-radius: 10px, softer multi-layer shadow, Best For explicitly names 'health/wellness ... professional') — its literal shadow example (0 2px 4px) was written for a small UI component, not a marketing card, so scaled up for real elevation at template scale rather than copied verbatim

name: Trusted Established
description: Sturdier borders and a firmer, more confident card shadow. Reads as substantial, not decorative.
harvestedFrom: uupm styles.csv row 46, Dimensional Layering (--elevation-2: 0 4px 6px rgba(0,0,0,0.1), --elevation-3: 0 10px 20px rgba(0,0,0,0.1)) — informs a firm mid-tier depth, adapted to the neutral rgba(16,24,40,*) convention the shipped templates already use for their own shadows (e.g. atlas's .at-cta__panel), not the source's pure-black rgba

uupm styles.csv row 27, Trust & Authority (Best For: 'Healthcare/medical ... financial services ... legal services') — status: deprecated upstream (superseded by a landing-page pattern, not a style), cited for its Best For framing only, not its Design System Variables, which are colour-led and out of scope here

name: Clinical Precise
description: Restrained, legible, unhurried. Larger touch targets and a visible focus ring — accessibility-first framing, not a decorative choice.
harvestedFrom: uupm styles.csv row 9, Accessible & Ethical (--focus-ring: 3-4px, --touch-target: 44x44px, font-size 16px+; Best For names healthcare/legal-compliance directly) — informs the focus-ring width and touch-target sizing below; its own colour/contrast values are out of scope here (palette's job, not a bundle's)

name: Grounded Property
description: Photography-forward: image cards get more rounding and more lift than UI chrome, with airier gaps so photos have room to breathe.
harvestedFrom: uupm styles.csv row 39, Bento Box Grid (--card-radius: 24px, box-shadow 0 4px 6px rgba(0,0,0,0.05)) — scaled down from 24px to 8px (24px read too playful/app-like for real estate marketing when checked) and its shadow deepened from barely-there to something visible at marketing-photography scale

name: Structural Industrial
description: No shadow anywhere, squared-off surfaces including the credential pills, tighter section spacing. Function over decoration.
harvestedFrom: uupm styles.csv row 1, Minimalism & Swiss Style (--shadow: none, --border-radius: 0px) and row 12, Flat Design (--shadow: none, --border-radius: 2px, 'corporate' listed in Best For) — both inform 'no ornamentation, sharp edges'; kept at 2px rather than upstream's literal 0px, since every one of the three shipped templates' own current radii is already non-zero at small sizes and 0px read like a rendering bug rather than a deliberate treatment when checked
